AYATANA YAMAKA—PAIRS ON BASES

Paccupannavāra 249. This person comprehends eye base. Does that person comprehend ear base? Yeṣ This person comprehends ear base. Does that person comprehends eye base? Yeṣ This person does not comprehend eye base. Does that person not comprehend ear base? Yeṣ This person does not comprehend ear base. Does that person not comprehend eye base? Yeṣ
